name: Justinian I
contribution: Eastern Roman Emperor who ruled from 527 to 565 (482-565).
legacy: One of the most enduring aspects of his legacy was the uniform rewriting of Roman law, the Corpus Juris Civilis, which was first applied throughout the Eastern Mediterannean and is still the basis of civil law in many modern states.

checks.lead: Justinian I (Latin: Iustinianus, Byzantine Greek: Ἰουστινιανός, romanized: Ioustinianós; 482 – 14 November 565), also known as Justinian the Great, was Roman emperor from 527 to 565.
